Element will support Waymo’s planned 2028 Toronto fleet

The expanded partnership covers charging, maintenance, cleaning and facilities, building on work in San Diego.

PRNewswire ↗16 October 2026English editorial summary
Story

Preparing a Canadian launch

Element Fleet Management expanded its Waymo partnership to Toronto for a planned 2028 autonomous ride-hailing launch, described as Waymo’s first Canadian operations. It follows the multi-year collaboration announced in June for support in San Diego.

The work behind autonomous trips

Element Mobility will coordinate staff, facilities, infrastructure and vehicle readiness. Maintenance, charging, energy management, cleaning and fleet data are included. This announcement concerns fleet operations rather than a new version of the driving system.

A future timetable

The partners expect to create hundreds of roles over time, including maintenance, validation driving and customer service. They have not specified a Toronto fleet size or exact opening date. Reduced downtime and improved utilization are intended outcomes, not results from an already operating Toronto service.
